definitions.gloss: independence; initiative; sense of agency; autonomy
definitions.explanation: The quality of thinking and acting on one's own judgment rather than passively following others. Often discussed in educational and workplace contexts as a desirable trait.

notes:
USAGE:
{主体性|しゅたいせい} is an abstract noun formed from ⟦{主体|しゅたい}→主体：11479_shutai⟧ (subject, agent) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). It is frequently used in education, business, and self-improvement contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主体性|しゅたいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have initiative)
- {主体性|しゅたいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to cultivate independence)
- {主体性|しゅたいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧ (to lack initiative)
- {主体性|しゅたいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person with initiative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{自主性|じしゅせい}→自主性：20447_jishusei⟧ also means independence or autonomy but focuses more on voluntary action without being told. {主体性|しゅたいせい} emphasizes the deeper quality of owning one's decisions and taking responsibility for them.
